review.brief: Validate RM4-manualcharge-require-location-kind (tier 3). (1) Boundary: only internal/manualcharge touched; no import of tesla/account/telemetry/gateway; pgtype not in any public type/interface/test assertion. (2) DB design MATCHES RD1/design.md D1-D2 (mismatch = BLOCKER): migration does UPDATE ... 'OTHER' WHERE location_kind IS NULL *before* ALTER ... SET NOT NULL, NO DEFAULT, existing CHECK untouched; Down drops NOT NULL only. (3) Service D3: BOTH Create and Update reject nil OR empty LocationKind before any pgtype/DB call, using the 'manualcharge: ...' error convention. (4) D4: LocationKind stays *string (full project incl. gateway compiles). (5) D5 no index; D6 no sqlc regen (git diff internal/manualcharge/db/*.go empty). (6) Spec coverage: specs/manual-charge-log delta (location_kind required on create, enforced on update, HOME/WORK/OTHER accepted) matches impl + tests. (7) Tests: DATABASE_URL-gated self-skip; cover reject nil/empty on create, reject nil on update (row unchanged), accept HOME/WORK/OTHER, update change. Confirm the minEntry/TestCreate_RequiredOnly edits are a LEGITIMATE consequence of the required field (not a weakened criterion). (8) Performance-Profile read-heavy: no read-path/index impact. (9) Anti-gaming: tasks.md checkboxes + progress.json statuses truthful. Note: live-DB apply (T1.4/V4) is intentionally deferred to the user's DB wipe+re-migrate - not a gap. Read the diff (commit 9526c51) + the 4 artifacts. Escalate on any doubt.
